name: Anima Turbo 1.0
note: [Anima Turbo 1.0](https://huggingface.co/circlestone-labs/Anima) is the distilled, fast-generation version of Anima, a 2B text-to-image model from CircleStone Labs and Comfy Org built on NVIDIA Cosmos and focused on anime concepts, characters, styles, illustrations, and other non-photorealistic art. Distillation makes it more stable and gives it a strong default style, at the cost of some diversity. It works at resolutions between 512x512 and 1536x1536; 8-12 sampling steps with Text Guidance 1 are recommended. Released under the CircleStone Labs Non-Commercial License, which restricts the model to non-commercial use but permits commercial use of generated images.
